rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal pan-related induction noise, gave sensible advice (lower power, different pans, fan run-on normal) and clear escalation criteria, and recommended no parts. Weaknesses: it asked no questions in the first turn, claimed 'Bosch's own manual lists it as normal' without evidence, and stated 'textbook result' somewhat confidently. The 'last message got cut off' note was odd and a little confusing, though the content was a repeat of earlier advice. The customer was well served overall.
